title.ko: 의무와 허용: had to · was allowed to · need to
title.en: Obligation and permission: had to · was allowed to · need to

explain.ko: must는 과거형이 없으므로 과거의 의무는 had to로 말합니다. 하지 않아도 되었던 일은 didn't have to / didn't need to입니다. 과거의 허락은 was / were allowed to로 말하고, 허락되지 않았던 일은 wasn't / weren't allowed to입니다. didn't have to는 '필요 없었다'는 뜻이고, mustn't는 '해서는 안 된다'(금지)입니다. 현재의 불필요는 don't have to / don't need to / needn't로 말합니다.
explain.en: Must has no past form, so use had to for a past obligation. For something that wasn't necessary use didn't have to or didn't need to. For past permission use was / were allowed to, and for something not permitted use wasn't / weren't allowed to. Didn't have to means 'it wasn't necessary', whereas mustn't means 'it is forbidden'. For present lack of necessity use don't have to, don't need to or needn't.

notes.ko: must의 과거형은 없으므로 had to를 씁니다.
notes.en: Must has no past form, so use had to.

notes.ko: don't have to는 '~하지 않아도 된다'이고 mustn't는 '~해서는 안 된다'입니다.
notes.en: Don't have to means 'not necessary'; mustn't means 'not allowed'.

notes.ko: 과거 의문문과 부정문은 did / didn't + have to입니다.
notes.en: In the past, questions and negatives use did / didn't + have to.

items.passage:
SWIMMING POOL RULES
All swimmers must shower before entering the pool. Children under twelve have to be accompanied by an adult. You mustn't run around the pool. A swimming cap is not compulsory, but long hair has to be tied back. You don't need to bring your own towel; you can hire one at the ticket desk.

trans.ko:

prompt.ko: 어릴 때의 규칙을 3문장으로 써 보세요: 해야 했던 일, 허락되지 않았던 일, 하지 않아도 되었던 일.
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about rules from your childhood: something you had to do, something you weren't allowed to do, and something you didn't have to do.

task.model: When I was a child, I had to go to bed at nine. We weren't allowed to use phones at dinner. But I didn't have to get up early at weekends.

model_trans.ko: 어릴 때 저는 아홉 시에 자야 했어요. 저녁 식사 중에는 휴대폰을 쓸 수 없었어요. 하지만 주말에는 일찍 일어나지 않아도 됐어요.
model_trans.en: When I was a child, I had to go to bed at nine. We weren't allowed to use phones at dinner. But I didn't have to get up early at weekends.
